text:
alex: follow-up on sideplane RFC: we need a clear egress strategy for callbacks when customers require IP allowlists. options?
nisha: two pragmatic paths: (1) preserve client src by routing via customer-facing ENI (no SNAT) or (2) SNAT at our regional relay and expose a stable egress IP. each has tradeoffs.
linus: src-preserve is nicest for network allowlists but introduces ENI lifecycle, route propagation, and multi-AZ failover complexity. brittle if we try to do it for everyone.
olivia: pinning ENIs/EIPs per tenant will blow our costs and operational surface. can we do a shared-static pool instead?
nisha: shared pool per region + X-Redwood-Tenant header is a reasonable middle ground. fixes app-level use-cases, but not network-level allowlists. call that "shared-static" tier.
alex: proposal: default = regional SNAT (lowest ops cost). Offer shared-static as a mid tier. Gate strict src-preserve to enterprise/dedicated and charge accordingly. Hybrid: prefer src-preserve if sideplane has an ENI, otherwise fall back to shared-static + header.
linus: failover concern: when sideplane withdraws prefixes during maintenance or outage, traffic will shift and we lose src-preserve. need soft-handoff to avoid blackholes.
infrastructure-bot: perf-note: adding per-tenant NAT path estimates +0.6-0.9ms p50. cost-ticket recommended for EIP/NAT-hours.
alex: implement withdraw grace window (30s) + active health checks before switching off src-preserve path. also add metric fallback_count and pinned_eni_count.
olivia: rollout plan: feature-flag the sideplane egress modes, beta with 3-5 pilot tenants. default remains regional SNAT. create runbook + pricing blurb before GA.
nisha: add tenant config field: egress_mode = ["regional-snat","shared-static","src-preserve"] and surface it in UI/audit logs.
linus: tests: allowlist acceptance test, peering-loss SLO test (simulate route withdrawal), chaos test for withdraw-grace window. I'll draft sequence diagrams.
alex: action items: linus -> spike BGP/route-prop options (3d); infra -> EIP/NAT cost estimate + open ticket; olivia -> rollout docs & runbook (7d). I'll open RFC follow-up with diagrams.
infrastructure-bot: created INFRA-5234 "sideplane egress modes cost & failover spike"
all: ack
